notes: Owner decision 063 (2026-11-06). E7A Dependency Ownership Standard: Core maintains independently released shared UI/Server libraries and optional Starter defaults; each product independently pins exact published runtime/framework versions, commits genuine frozen lockfiles and owns security/QA/release/rollback. Automation provides read-only evidence and reviewed proposals, no product writes or deploy. New products adopt after this normative release; existing consumers migrate via targeted product-owned review PR at next relevant dependency/security change. Explicit peerDependencies/dev tooling exceptions allowed under the documented evidence policy. This minor release supersedes v2.0.0 as normative baseline without re-publishing Core packages, force-upgrading consumers, activating App/timer/Actions CI, or weakening product-scoped release approvals.
